data.value: Allows a child class to inherit methods and properties from a parent class. • Key Keyword: Uses the Inherits keyword to establish an 'is-a' relationship (e.g., Dog is an Animal). • Main Advantage: Prevents duplicate code and establishes a clean hierarchical class structure.

data.name: TextBox2.Text
data.value:
Public Class Animal Public Name As String Public Sub Eat() Console.WriteLine(Name & " is eating.") End Sub End Class
Public Class Dog Inherits Animal Public Sub Bark() Console.WriteLine("Bark!") End Sub End Class
